explanation: For continuously differentiable fields (P,Q) on R², conservativeness is equivalent to P_y=Q_x everywhere. For I, both derivatives equal x, so it is conservative. For II, P_y=2y and Q_x=-4y², which differ at y=1. For III, P_y=x cos(xy) and Q_x=-y sin(xy), which differ at (1,0). Therefore only I is conservative.
